notes: Reviewed 2026-11-15: mRNA-seq arm of a ribosome-profiling protocol (fragmented, gel size-selected RNA); excluded by user decision. | Only the mRNA-Seq samples are candidates (RPF samples not shown). mRNA samples labelled total_rnaseq (rRNA-depleted, alkaline-fragmented mRNA), but libraries were size-selected as in Guo 2010 with a 25-nt spike-in, so fragments may be short (unsure). MM = M9-type phosphate salts + glucose -> other_minimal. Heat (47 °C 7 min) and osmotic (0.3 M NaCl 20 min) are acute shifts from mid-log cells, so pre-shift phase kept (inferred). Unstressed LB and MM samples are controls. Oxygen/culture mode not stated.
